<document id="card-controls">
CardˆcontrolsˆCardˆcontrolsˆletˆyouˆdecideˆwhereˆyourˆcardˆcanˆbeˆused.ˆChangesˆtakeˆeffectˆstraightˆaway.ˆ##ˆControlsˆyouˆcanˆsetˆInˆtheˆapp,ˆtapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆthenˆControls.ˆYouˆcanˆswitchˆeachˆofˆtheseˆonˆorˆoff:ˆ-ˆOnlineˆpurchasesˆ-ˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆ(inˆstoresˆandˆonlineˆwithˆforeignˆmerchants)ˆ-ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ-ˆContactlessˆpaymentsˆ##ˆCommonˆmix-upsˆ-ˆAˆdeclinedˆonlineˆorderˆfromˆaˆforeignˆwebsiteˆisˆoftenˆtheˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆcontrol,ˆnotˆtheˆOnlineˆpurchasesˆone.ˆ-ˆSwitchingˆoffˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆonˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆdoesn'tˆaffectˆyourˆvirtualˆcard,ˆwhichˆcan'tˆbeˆusedˆatˆATMsˆanyway.ˆ-ˆControlsˆdon'tˆchangeˆyourˆlimits.ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆyourˆplan.ˆ##ˆControlsˆversusˆfreezingˆControlsˆblockˆcertainˆkindsˆofˆtransactions.ˆFreezingˆblocksˆalmostˆeverything.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyourˆcardˆisˆatˆrisk,ˆfreezeˆit.ˆSupportˆcanˆexplainˆyourˆcurrentˆsettings,ˆbutˆyouˆchangeˆcontrolsˆyourselfˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fx-fees-premium">
ForeignˆtransactionˆfeesˆonˆPremiumˆOnˆtheˆPremiumˆplan,ˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆ0%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆ##ˆWhenˆitˆappliesˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆinˆaˆstoreˆorˆonlineˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroad.ˆThoseˆhaveˆtheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆExampleˆOnˆPremium,ˆaˆpurchaseˆabroadˆcostsˆexactlyˆtheˆconvertedˆamount.ˆNoˆfeeˆisˆadded.ˆ##ˆExchangeˆrateˆWeˆuseˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles,ˆwithˆnoˆmarkup.ˆChooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆwhenˆaˆterminalˆoffersˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆdollars.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆIfˆaˆforeignˆpurchaseˆisˆrefunded,ˆweˆalsoˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆamount.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆconvertedˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="travel-blocked-regions">
Countriesˆwhereˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆTallowbrookˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆinˆcomprehensivelyˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆandˆregions.ˆPurchases,ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆandˆonlineˆordersˆfromˆmerchantsˆbasedˆthereˆareˆdeclined.ˆ##ˆWhyˆUSˆbanksˆandˆcardˆprogramsˆmustˆfollowˆUSˆsanctionsˆrules.ˆWeˆcan'tˆmakeˆexceptions,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆunblockˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆSigningˆinˆfromˆabroadˆYouˆcanˆusuallyˆuseˆtheˆappˆfromˆanywhere,ˆbutˆaccessˆfromˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆmayˆbeˆblockedˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆDeclinedˆsomewhereˆelse?ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆaˆcountryˆthatˆisn'tˆsanctionedˆandˆyourˆcardˆisˆdeclined,ˆtheˆcauseˆisˆmoreˆlikelyˆaˆfraudˆcheck,ˆyourˆcardˆcontrols,ˆorˆyourˆbalance.ˆSeeˆ"Whyˆwasˆmyˆcardˆdeclined?".ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆabroadˆInternationalˆwiresˆtoˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆareˆalsoˆblocked.ˆWiresˆtoˆotherˆcountriesˆmayˆstillˆbeˆreviewedˆbeforeˆthey'reˆsent.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
